protobuf.reason: BSD-3-Clause declared as a free-text label. Cisco skill-scanner dependency (KOBE-341).

google-cloud-aiplatform.reason: Apache-2.0 declared as a free-text label. Optional Vertex AI client the scanner's LLM extras pull in; the Job never uses it (no network) (KOBE-341).

google-cloud-bigquery.reason: Apache-2.0 declared as a free-text label. Dependency of google-cloud-aiplatform, unused in the Job (KOBE-341).

multidict.reason: Apache-2.0 declared as a free-text label (approved for 6.7.1 in the Orbit eval image, KOBE-92). aiohttp dependency (KOBE-341).

regex.reason: Apache-2.0 with code under the CNRI Python license (BSD-like, permissive, not copyleft); the same licence was approved for another version in the Orbit eval image. tiktoken dependency (KOBE-341).

uritemplate.reason: Dual BSD-3-Clause or Apache-2.0 written as free text. google-api-python-client dependency (KOBE-341).

pcodedmp.reason: GPL-3.0: copyleft, outside the family. oletools' VBA p-code disassembler, pulled in by Cisco skill-scanner's Office macro analysis; it runs only inside the optional scanner image as a separate process, but the image distributes it. Options for the gate: accept for the optional image, or build the image without pcodedmp (olevba then skips p-code analysis) (KOBE-341).

tiktoken.reason: MIT declared with the license text instead of an SPDX id (approved for 0.13.0 in the Orbit eval image). litellm dependency (KOBE-341).

typing_extensions.reason: Python Software Foundation license: permissive, not copyleft (approved for 4.16.0 in the Orbit eval image) (KOBE-341).

aiohappyeyeballs.reason: PSF-2.0 (the PyPI classifier maps to Python-2.0): permissive, not copyleft (approved for 2.7.1 in the Orbit eval image). aiohttp dependency (KOBE-341).

google-crc32c.reason: No license metadata; the project (googleapis/python-crc32c) is Apache-2.0 and the wheel ships its LICENSE. google-resumable-media dependency (KOBE-341).
